mapper.insert: insert into order_status_log (id, order_no, from_status, to_status, operator, remark) values (#{id}, #{orderNo}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{operator}, #{remark})
mapper.select: select id, order_no, from_status, to_status, operator, remark, created_at from order_status_log where order_no = #{orderNo} order by id
